description: This file defines the class BSE within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically handling BLIP (Big Large Image or Picture) objects in the Escher drawing components. It includes constants for various image types, properties for the BLIP object and its parent container, and methods to set/get these properties.

classes.name: BSE
classes.description: Represents a BLIP (Big Large Image or Picture) in the Escher drawing components, with constants for image types and methods to manage its properties.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Assigns the parent BstoreContainer to this BSE object.

methods.name: setBlip
methods.description: Sets the BSE\Blip object and assigns this BSE as its parent.
